source='''def transform(grid):
    colors = {value for row in grid for value in row if value != 0}
    objects = []
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == color]
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
        crop = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
        objects.append((r0, r1, c0, c1, crop))
    row_spread = max(o[1] for o in objects) - min(o[0] for o in objects)
    col_spread = max(o[3] for o in objects) - min(o[2] for o in objects)
    horizontal = col_spread >= row_spread
    objects.sort(key=lambda o: (o[2] + o[3]) if horizontal else (o[0] + o[1]))
    if horizontal:
        height = max(len(o[4]) for o in objects)
        width = sum(len(o[4][0]) for o in objects)
        out = [[0] * width for _ in range(height)]
        offset = 0
        for *_, obj in objects:
            for r, row in enumerate(obj):
                for c, value in enumerate(row):
                    out[r][offset + c] = value
            offset += len(obj[0])
    else:
        height = sum(len(o[4]) for o in objects)
        width = max(len(o[4][0]) for o in objects)
        out = [[0] * width for _ in range(height)]
        offset = 0
        for *_, obj in objects:
            for r, row in enumerate(obj):
                for c, value in enumerate(row):
                    out[offset + r][c] = value
            offset += len(obj)
    return out
'''
